Current balance and expected end-of-month balance, with hideable amounts.

With Advanced Protection your data is encrypted on this device before it syncs. The cloud only holds unreadable data: no one, not even the people who run Bucktrail, can read it without your security phrase or recovery key.
The server only sees technical information: your account, how many items you have and when you sync.
If you lose both your security phrase and your recovery key, your cloud data can no longer be recovered. No one can do it for you.
Before turning it on, update Bucktrail on every device signed in to this account: older versions will stop syncing.
At least 10 characters: four or more words work best. Don\'t use your account password. The phrase never leaves your device.
The phrase must be at least 10 characters long.
Keep it somewhere other than this phone, on paper or in a password manager. You\'ll need it if you forget your security phrase. It won\'t be shown again.
